credentials: MFA 1997 Univ of Michigan at Ann Arbor
name: AMY BARRY

ratings.comment: This is for ENG169 - Poetic Forms, which wasn't listed above. Prof. Barry is a very good teacher, and if you attend all the classes there's nothing to worry about. However, make sure you do not miss any classes, because your grade will tank. There is also some memorization involved in the midterm, so watch out for that.

AQB is really passionate about poetry. Kind of strict, but you can tell she really enjoys her field. Tends to often dominate class discussion. Would require a student presentation but never left enough time for a proper presentation and would constantly but in during presentation. Overall solid teacher but you have to go with the flow

Amy is a committed teacher who runs a fairly tight ship. You'll need to do the readings and all your homework before coming to class, but when done she is quick to engage all the students with the texts. She is clearly a talented writer and is happy to share her knowledge with anyone who asks. Do your work and be interested and you'll do fine.
AQB is a great professor and will make you interested, whether you want to or not.

Amy is my favorite professor on campus. She says what she thinks, and is very helpful. She may come off as having an attitude to some, but if you can't take it, it's probably because you didn't put enough thought into the piece of crap poem you wrote (or you forgot to bring it altogether).

I learned so much in her class just by looking at the comments she made on my work. Her class was definitely the highlight of my week. Could be a little hard to figure out what she wanted from you at times, but as long as you do the work and show progress on your poems you should get an A.
clearly, she's a very insecure teacher.

Funny and intelligent. She gives really good feedback and keeps class structured nicely. She's a bit of an oddball, but, overall, definitely a good professor. Maybe there's a big difference between how she teaches grad classes and undergrad, but I definitely recommend her if you're taking undergrad.
she has a big attitude problem. takes it out on students. she can be a good teacher when she wants to be, but we all had a problem with her.

Very efficient with time, makes a single 2 hour period feel more useful than three regular lectures. Will often drop useful tidbits (e.g., "imitative fallacy") as a quick aside - be prepared to jot these down, or you may found you've missed half the material in the class. Great choice of readings.
AQB rocks! She is an awesome teacher! Classes are very fast paced, and it is an incredible experience to take a class with someone so talented.
